title: Toy packet route
purpose: Understand that a packet is forwarded hop by hop through a simplified network.
description: A synthetic packet travels from a learner device through a router to a destination network. This is a teaching model, not a live network tool.

rules: If router_available is false, forwarding stops at the device.
If router_available is true and destination_reachable is false, the router cannot deliver the packet to the destination.
If both controls are true, the model delivers the packet to the destination.
data.reset: Restore both controls to true and packet_location to device.

fallback: Start with the router and destination both available. Predict where the packet ends. Then make the router unavailable and predict again. Explain why the packet cannot be forwarded. This is a paper exercise; no real network traffic is sent.
